title: Theosophy
author: Rudolf Steiner (1910 trans)
description: Rudolf Steiner introduces his understanding of the human being as body, soul and spirit. The work connects spiritual knowledge with ideas of destiny, reincarnation and the development of higher perception within Anthroposophy.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/theosophyanintr01steigoog).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
